messages:
Marco (Collections): Heads up — Drifter.ai overdue again. Invoice `INV-2026-033` for $48,700 (Feb usage) is 45 days past due. I tried phone, no pickup.

InvoicesBot: Automated reminder sent — invoice INV-2026-033 is 45 days overdue. :rotating_light:

Aisha (Billing Ops): Sent dunning #2 email on Mon (copied their billing alias). No ack yet. I included the itemized usage CSV.

Lena (Acct Exec): They replied to my thread last week saying the spike was internal sandbox tests and asked for itemized usage and a 30-day extension. Said ops team is OOO until Thu.

Marco (Collections): We need a formal commitment. My recommendation: payment plan with an initial payment and two follow-ups. Proposed draft below — open to adjustments:

```
Proposed plan:
- Payment 1: $25,000 due within 7 days
- Payment 2: $15,000 due in 30 days
- Payment 3: remaining balance due in 60 days
- No service suspension while plan is active; late fee applies if miss installment
```

Chris (CFO): Prefer stronger upfront. Can we ask for $30k now? Also check whether legal wants interest waived if they sign a mutual release. We should avoid long tails.

Aisha (Billing Ops): We can set up an ACH link and draft a payment plan doc. If they sign and make initial payment, we can pause escalation. I can send draft terms today.

Lena (Acct Exec): I'll ping their VP of Ops and attach the itemized usage again. I'll offer the 30-day extension only if they sign the payment plan and provide a short note confirming sandbox usage and mitigation. Pinged them: @drifter-billing — can you confirm receipt and whether finance will approve ACH? :email:

Drifter Billing (customer): Thanks — we've seen the itemization. Ops says the spike was a misconfigured CI job; we need to confirm final numbers with infra. Can we get 30 days and a two-installment plan? Will confirm by Thu. — Maya

Marco (Collections): Ok — Lena, confirm by EOD Thu. If no signed plan + initial payment by EOD Friday, escalate to legal for a demand letter and flag account for suspension on 60 days. Also please add an internal note to withhold new credits. :eyes:

Aisha (Billing Ops): Noted. I'll draft the payment plan PDF and include standard late fee (1.5%/mo). Will share for review in #finance before sending.

Chris (CFO): Agreed on escalation path. If they push back hard, we can consider a one-time credit for sandbox noise but only if they sign terms and commit to remediation.

Lena (Acct Exec): I'll follow up with Maya after their infra sync. Scheduling a quick call Thu 10:30am PT. I'll post the calendar invite here. :calendar:

Marco (Collections): Thanks — keep me posted. If we get the signed plan, I'll close the dunning ticket and mark as payment plan active. If not, I'll open legal escalation Monday morning.

Aisha (Billing Ops): Draft will be in the channel in ~2 hours.

Lena (Acct Exec): On it.

Marco (Collections): 👍
